item.title: DA Withdraws Felony Assault Charge Against Gavin McKenna
item.description: Penn State hockey star Gavin McKenna is no longer facing the most serious charge stemming from an altercation in downtown State College on Saturday. After a review of video evidence, Centre County District Attorney Bernie Cantorna is withdrawing the charge of felony aggravated assault against the 18-year-old forward from Yukon, Canada, he said at a press conference Friday in Bellefonte. item.title: Police: Suspect in Custody, Charges Pending After State College Home Invasion
item.description: A suspect is in custody and charges are pending after an overnight home invasion in State College, according to borough police. Officers responded at about 2 a.m. Friday to a home on Crabapple Drive and determined that the residents fought off the intruder, police wrote in a statement. item.title: Penn State Wrestling Thrashes Michigan 38-3
item.description: No. 1 Penn State wrestling continued to dominate its dual meet schedule, winning nine of 10 bouts for a 38-3 victory against Michigan on Friday night in Ann Arbor. Luke Lilledahl, Marcus Blaze, Mitchell Mesenbrink, Levi Haines and Josh Barr all won by technical fall, while Shayne Van Ness claimed a major decision. item.title: Penn State Student Seriously Injured in State College Hit-and-Run Crash
item.description: A man was arrested after a hit-and-run crash that left a pedestrian with serious injuries early Saturday morning in State College, according to borough police. The crash happened at about 2:30 a.m. at the intersection of East Beaver Avenue and South Garner Street. The driver had left the scene when police arrived, according to a department media release. item.description: Under James Franklin, Penn State often opted for splashy hires at the coordinator positions, bringing in coaches with a proven track record at other stops.
